_about: Sprint 10a (ADR-0032) — the Estatuto fallback gold set, plan §D.10.1. Run with `php artisan estatuto:gold-eval`.
_positive_profile: test-fullgap@example.com — convenio 7, ACCIÓN E INTERVENCIÓN SOCIAL ESTATAL. No prose document of any retrieval status, no chunks of any status, no salary table, no reference fact. classifyProseGap() = never_ingested, so the fallback is the only way this employee gets an answer.
_negative_profile: test-andalucia@example.com — convenio 4. One HISTORICAL convenio text with 151 chunks. classifyProseGap() = expired_only, so under ultraactividad (ET 86.4) the Estatuto must NOT substitute: every answerable question must escalate estatuto_fallback_gap with no floor_decision.fallback key.
_second_negative_profile: test-midingest@example.com — convenio 16. One HISTORICAL convenio text with ZERO chunks. Reaches expired_only by D3's document-existence check rather than by having chunks, which is the mid-ingest fail-closed path. Same expectation as the negative profile.
_note_on_convenio_16: The build authorization's D5 named convenio 16 as the POSITIVE profile. D3 (a review addition) tightened never_ingested to require no prose document of ANY status, and convenio 16 has a historical one — so it moved to the other side of the split. Convenio 7 is the only non-fixture convenio in the corpus that satisfies D3.

_expectations.answer: must answer, grounded, from the named Estatuto article, with the fallback caveat persisted on chat_messages.content
_expectations.escalate_salary: must escalate on the salary path with NO floor_decision.fallback key — the fallback is prose-only
_expectations.escalate_sensitive: must escalate on the pre-router guardrail, before the router and before any fallback decision

_gold_set_correction: Q6 was listed as 'clean' in plan §D.10.1, which was written without checking it against the guardrail layer. Measured: the sensitive-topic guardrail fires pre-router on a despido question, on every profile. That is the product behaving correctly — dismissal goes to a human — so the expectation is corrected here rather than the guardrail being weakened to make a gold row pass.
_note_on_negative_runs: On the negative profiles the invariant is 'no Estatuto answer and no fallback key', not a specific reason. Some questions are stopped by an earlier gate that has nothing to do with the fallback: Q6 by the guardrail on every profile, and Q3/Q4 on convenio 4 by the reference-fact pre-check, because that convenio has a verified periodo-de-prueba fact and the test employee has no job category to scope it to. Both still satisfy the split, and Q3/Q4 doubling as evidence that the pre-check still runs ahead of the prose path is what invariant T8 asserts.
